# Bundled browser dependencies

BuildSim serves these files locally so student laptops do not need internet
access while the viewer is running.

- `three.module.js`: Three.js r160, MIT license, copyright Three.js Authors.
- `OrbitControls.js`: Three.js r160 example module, MIT license, copyright
  Three.js Authors.
- `jspdf.umd.min.js`: jsPDF 2.5.1, MIT license. Its upstream license and
  copyright notice are retained in the file header.

The project-level [LICENSE](../../LICENSE) is also MIT.
